daniel-rozin--fabric-mirror.why_en: Strips of cloth turn their light or dark side to weave a soft picture of whoever stands in front.
daniel-rozin--fabric-mirror.why_zh: 一条条布翻出浅色或深色的一面，织出站在面前的人的柔软影像。

breakfast--echo.why_en: A wall of flip-discs clatters into your silhouette and keeps a fading echo of how you just moved.
breakfast--echo.why_zh: 一面翻转圆片墙哗啦啦地翻出你的剪影，还留着你刚才动作的渐渐消失的回声。

felice-varini--concentric-eccentric-carc.why_en: Yellow shards painted across a whole medieval city snap into perfect circles from one single spot.
felice-varini--concentric-eccentric-carc.why_zh: 画在整座中世纪古城上的黄色碎片，只在一个位置看过去，会拼成完美的同心圆。

jr--the-secret-of-the-great-pyramid.why_en: Paper pasted on a flat courtyard makes the Louvre pyramid seem to rise out of a deep quarry.
jr--the-secret-of-the-great-pyramid.why_zh: 贴在平整广场上的纸，让卢浮宫金字塔看起来像是从一个深深的采石坑里升起。

anish-kapoor--descension.why_en: A black whirlpool spins in the ground as if the floor were draining into the earth.
anish-kapoor--descension.why_zh: 一个黑色漩涡在地面上旋转，好像地板正在往地底下流走。

es-devlin--please-feed-the-lions.why_en: Feed a word to a lion in Trafalgar Square and it roars back a line of poetry.
es-devlin--please-feed-the-lions.why_zh: 给 Trafalgar Square 的狮子喂一个词，它就吼出一句诗。

jr--kikito.why_en: A giant toddler peers over the US–Mexico border fence, turning a wall into a curious look.
jr--kikito.why_zh: 一个巨大的幼儿从美墨边境墙上探头张望，把一堵墙变成了一次好奇的注视。

lorenzo-quinn--support.why_en: Two giant hands rise from the canal to hold up a sinking Venice building.
lorenzo-quinn--support.why_zh: 一双巨手从运河里伸出来，托住一栋正在下沉的威尼斯建筑。

studio-drift--drifter.why_en: A heavy concrete block floats slowly through the room like a cloud.
studio-drift--drifter.why_zh: 一块沉重的混凝土方块像云一样慢慢飘过房间。

skullmapping--gallery-invasion.why_en: A painted character escapes its frame and runs around the gallery walls.
skullmapping--gallery-invasion.why_zh: 画里的角色逃出画框，在展厅的墙上四处乱跑。

doug-aitken--mirage.why_en: A house covered in mirrors disappears into the desert it reflects.
doug-aitken--mirage.why_zh: 一栋贴满镜子的房子，消失在它所映照的沙漠里。

alex-chinneck--a-pound-of-flesh-for-50p.why_en: A house built from wax bricks melts like a candle over a month.
alex-chinneck--a-pound-of-flesh-for-50p.why_zh: 一栋用蜡砖砌成的房子，在一个月里像蜡烛一样慢慢融化。

philippe-parreno--my-room-is-another-fis.why_en: Balloon fish drift at head height and bump into you, so the room becomes a fish tank.
philippe-parreno--my-room-is-another-fis.why_zh: 气球做的鱼在头的高度漂浮，还会轻轻撞到你，整个房间变成了鱼缸。

chiharu-shiota--a-walk-through-the-line.why_en: Threads knotted through a building let you walk inside a drawing in the air.
chiharu-shiota--a-walk-through-the-line.why_zh: 线在整栋建筑里穿梭打结，让你走进一幅画在空中的画里。

antony-gormley--another-time.why_en: A lone iron figure in the sea is swallowed and revealed by the tide every day.
antony-gormley--another-time.why_zh: 海里一个孤零零的铁人，每天被潮水淹没，又被潮水露出来。
